messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 7 March, 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 7 March between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close any open documents before 20:00. Email and the case management system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
